build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=false cargo build --release --manifest-path tools/perf-baseline/Cargo.toml --bin litchi-perf-baseline
lock_policy: External copy of tools/perf-baseline/Cargo.lock passed through -Z lockfile-path and resolver.lockfile-path; repository lockfiles unchanged. Facade validation used a separate external root lock with cc 1.7.0 downgraded to cached 1.6.0.
timing_scope: Opening, fixture and command-vector preparation, serialization, source/output checks, all-text readback and UserEdit history verification excluded. String path parsing, native/unified publication and patch destruction included. Native set_shape_text_chunks once per4096 edit; each inner chunk <=256. One atomic facade edit. Default256MiB snapshot limit through4096; explicit1GiB at10000.

method: Fourteen separate pair invocations in count order (1,10,100,256,1000,4096,10000), eager then positional. Native leg then unified leg; one warmup and five samples each. No concurrent builds or tests. Runtime sources committed; documentation uncommitted. Blocked leg order, not alternating AB/BA.
limitations: Synthetic same-slide text closure edits, local warm prepared owners, blocked native-then-unified ordering, five samples. No cold opens, command JSON conversion, geometry, broad corpus or allocation profiling in this matrix. Both source and final output bytes match0220. Dedicated regression tests separately qualify source-probe count and existing-text-independent planning allocations.
